<text x="217" y="515" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">System network</text>

<circle cx="45" cy="285" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="45" y="291" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<circle cx="25" cy="420" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="25" y="426" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<circle cx="157" cy="420" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="157" y="426" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>

<text x="289" y="426" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<circle cx="45" cy="339" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="45" y="345" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
<circle cx="445" cy="90" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="445" y="96" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="472" y="96" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Controller or CPU fault</text>
<text x="472" y="120" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">watchdog, memory, CPU load</text>
<circle cx="445" cy="156" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="445" y="162" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="472" y="162" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Power supply failure</text>
<text x="472" y="186" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">primary or redundant, low DC</text>

<text x="472" y="294" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Station offline</text>
<text x="472" y="318" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">HMI server, operator station</text>

<text x="445" y="426" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<text x="472" y="426" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Time sync fault</text>
<text x="472" y="450" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">lost NTP or GPS time</text>
<circle cx="445" cy="486" r="16" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="445" y="492" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
<text x="472" y="492" font-size="18" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Cabinet cooling</text>
<text x="472" y="516" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">high temp, fan fail, door open</text>
</svg>

figs.name: alarms-in-dcs-operator-response-flowchart
figs.alt: alarms in DCS operator response flowchart from alarm limit to corrective action
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a DCS alarm works: the process value crosses a limit, the alarm appears, the operator checks the process and acts until it clears.
figs.after_h2: What Are Alarms in a DCS?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Operator response flowchart for a process alarm in a DCS</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How an Operator Responds to a DCS Alarm</text>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="330" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="225.0" y="84.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process value crosses</text>
<text x="225.0" y="107.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">its set alarm limit</text>
<line x1="225" y1="120" x2="225" y2="142" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="144" width="330" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="225.0" y="168.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DCS raises the alarm</text>
<text x="225.0" y="191.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">on the operator screen</text>
<line x1="225" y1="204" x2="225" y2="226" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="228" width="330" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="225.0" y="252.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Operator checks</text>
<text x="225.0" y="275.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the process</text>
<line x1="225" y1="288" x2="225" y2="310" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="312" width="330" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="225.0" y="336.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Corrective action</text>
<text x="225.0" y="359.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">adjust valve or setpoint</text>
<line x1="225" y1="372" x2="225" y2="402" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="225,404.0 375.0,456 225,508.0 75.0,456" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="225" y="451.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Back in</text>
<text x="225" y="473.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">normal range?</text>
<polyline points="75,456 35,456 35,342 58,342" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="52" y="482" font-size="17" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<line x1="375" y1="456" x2="448" y2="456" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="410" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="450" y="420" width="320" height="72" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="610.0" y="450.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Alarm clears</text>
<text x="610.0" y="473.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">plant back to normal</text>
<rect x="440" y="70" width="335" height="200" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="607.5" y="106.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example: reactor</text>
<text x="607.5" y="129.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Reactor temperature</text>
<text x="607.5" y="152.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">exceeds its safe limit</text>
<text x="607.5" y="175.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DCS triggers a high</text>
<text x="607.5" y="198.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">temperature alarm</text>
<text x="607.5" y="221.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Operator reduces heat</text>
<text x="607.5" y="244.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">input or stops the feed</text>
<text x="400" y="540" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Good alarms warn early, before a trip or shutdown occurs</text>
</svg>

figs.name: alarms-in-dcs-eight-types-infographic
figs.alt: eight types of alarms in DCS: process, equipment, safety, quality, maintenance and more
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog listing eight DCS alarm types, what each one protects and a typical example, from process and equipment alarms to security and system alarms.
figs.after_h2: Types of Alarms in DCS – Introduction
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 570" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Eight types of alarms in DCS with what each protects and an example</title>
<rect width="800" height="570" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7f1d1d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">8 Types of Alarms in a DCS</text>
<rect x="25" y="60" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="57" cy="94" r="18" fill="#b91c1c"/>
<text x="57" y="100" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="87" y="101" font-size="20" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Process alarm</text>
<text x="47" y="132" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">value out of normal range</text>
<text x="47" y="157" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. low boiler drum level</text>
<rect x="410" y="60" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="94" r="18" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="442" y="100" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="472" y="101" font-size="20" fill="#c2410c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Equipment alarm</text>
<text x="432" y="132" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">machine stress or failure</text>
<text x="432" y="157" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. pump vibration</text>
<rect x="25" y="186" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="57" cy="220" r="18" fill="#dc2626"/>
<text x="57" y="226" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="87" y="227" font-size="20" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Safety alarm</text>
<text x="47" y="258" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">risk to people and plant</text>
<text x="47" y="283" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. toxic gas detected</text>
<rect x="410" y="186" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="220" r="18" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="442" y="226" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="472" y="227" font-size="20" fill="#7c3aed" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Quality alarm</text>
<text x="432" y="258" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">product off specification</text>
<text x="432" y="283" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. pH deviation</text>
<rect x="25" y="312" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="57" cy="346" r="18" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="57" y="352" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="87" y="353" font-size="20" fill="#0369a1" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Maintenance alarm</text>
<text x="47" y="384" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">service or calibration due</text>
<text x="47" y="409" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. filter replacement</text>
<rect x="410" y="312" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="346" r="18" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="442" y="352" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<text x="472" y="353" font-size="20" fill="#0f766e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Communication alarm</text>
<text x="432" y="384" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">lost data link</text>
<text x="432" y="409" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. remote I/O link failure</text>
<rect x="25" y="438" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="57" cy="472" r="18" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="57" y="478" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
<text x="87" y="479" font-size="20" fill="#4338ca" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Security alarm</text>
<text x="47" y="510" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">unauthorized access</text>
<text x="47" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. USB insertion detected</text>
<rect x="410" y="438" width="365" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="472" r="18" fill="#374151"/>
<text x="442" y="478" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">8</text>
<text x="472" y="479" font-size="20" fill="#374151" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">System alarm</text>
<text x="432" y="510" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">DCS hardware fault</text>
<text x="432" y="535" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">e.g. power supply failure</text>
</svg>
